```

Webhook delivery: 502 Bad Gateway -> retried 3x

```

Who can join enablement? :calendar:

Priya (Onboarding): I'll prepare a minimal runbook and coordinate docs updates. Also capture permission steps for regen token.

I'll create calendar invites and a short customer-facing note. Tagging internal owners: @Taylor (Solutions) / @Priya (Onboarding) / @Jon (Support).

Maya (CS): action items assigned. If manual backfill needed, raise to eng-runbooks and cc eng-oncall. Closing loop here unless anything else. :thumbsup:
